plan: A support who grabs an enemy with his chain and can pull an ally in danger to safety with his lantern.
aSurveiller: His Q (Death Sentence). His chain pulls you towards him and he can dash at you: stay behind your minions.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: his chain (Q) stops on the first one hit.
After a missed Q, he is vulnerable for several seconds: time to attack.
When he drops his lantern (W), be careful: an ally can appear next to him.
forces: Saves an ally with his lantern.
Lots of crowd control: pull, knock back, slow.
faiblesses: Useless when his chain is on cooldown.

sorts.P: Collects souls of dead enemies to grow stronger.
sorts.Q: Chain that pulls the enemy; he can then dash to them.
sorts.W: Lantern that shields and pulls an ally to him.
sorts.E: Chain swipe that knocks back and slows.
sorts.R: Cage whose walls slow and damage.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 2, at any point in the game.
